Class GameMove

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.persistence.GameMove
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameMove extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a single game move saved to disk. This class encapsulates all attributes that are relevant for various move types. Unused payloads for a specific move type are left uninitialized or at their default values.
